subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — committed tiers, volume discounts, and cross-region usage
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers and geo usage question

Hi Katie / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our ask, attaching the Redwood pricing sheet (Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_2025.xlsx) with per-token MSRP and example commit tiers. Two quick questions to make an accurate proposal:

- Expected monthly token volume by region (US / EU / APAC) for the first 6-12 months.
- Whether Acme prefers a single global commit (one committed token pool applied across regions) or region-specific commits (separate commitments per region).

High level on commitments: we offer step-based volume discounts off list per-token rates; larger committed annual spends unlock bigger % discounts and reduced overage rates. We can pilot with a short-term committed minimum if that helps procurement.

Attached: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_2025.xlsx (pricing table + example math). I can follow up with an example quote once I have the region breakout.

Next step: want to set a 30-minute call this week to walk the commit math and cross-region rules? I have availability Wed/Thu morning PST.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_2025.xlsx
From: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@acme-retail.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers and geo usage question

Jordan —

Thanks for the follow-up and the spreadsheet. A few things we need clarified before we loop procurement:

1) Commit semantics: does a committed token pool apply globally by default (tokens usable across regions) or do we need to allocate per-region?
2) If usage crosses regions, how are overages priced? Is it based on origin region or billing region?
3) Any uplift / surcharge for APAC traffic? Our APAC team will be heavy after launch and we need to know if that inflates costs.
4) Can you do a 3-month pilot with a higher overage rate but a small committed credit (e.g., a $25k pilot credit)?
5) We need confirmation on VAT handling and whether the list rates are VAT-exclusive for EU invoicing.

Procurement (cc’d) will need a firm doc for legal / finance review. Also, we are SOC 2 Type II in scope for vendors — can you confirm Redwood’s compliance artifacts and whether we can get an SOC attestation?

Appreciate a clear table showing: list price per token, 3 commit tiers with % discounts, overage rules, and region weighting assumptions.

Thanks,
Katie Liao
Director, Product Platform | Acme Retail
katie.liao@acme-retail.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers and geo usage question

Marissa / Markus / Grace —

Looping you in. Acme is asking for clarity on global vs region-specific commits and whether we can offer a short pilot credit. They also want SOC 2 artifacts (we have those, Grace — can you share?).

Specifically: they want a) table of list price, 3 commit tiers and discounts, b) rules for cross-region overages and c) any APAC surcharge.

We’d like to propose: 15% off list for a 500B token annual commit (global), 10% for 250B, and 5% for 100B. Pilot option: $25k credit for 3 months + higher overage (we keep overage at list). Are we okay with that discount band? Also need guidance on APAC uplift.

Markus — what floor do we need to protect margins? Grace — can you confirm SOC 2 and EU VAT wording?

Thanks,
Jordan

On Wed, Aug 13, 2025 at 09:15 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan / Marissa —
>
> For enterprise commits: we typically allow up to 18% list discount at the very top of the band for multi-year, strategic deals, but for a first-year committed agreement 15% on a sizable commit (500B tokens) is within standard approval. 10% for 250B is fine.
>
> APAC: we have historically applied a region uplift between 3–5% depending on support/region egress and local invoicing complexity. For Acme I recommend we present a 3% APAC surcharge on token billing for APAC-originated usage; alternatively offer a global commit with a clause that APAC traffic is weighted at 1.03x for billing calculations.
>
> On rollover: we do not automatically roll unused committed tokens across years by default; we can offer a 6-month rollover at reduced credit value (50%) as a concession.
>
> Margin floor: agree to 15% discount for year one if we keep APAC uplift and do not offer full rollover.
>
> Markus
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API quote and cross-region pricing (updated)

Hi Katie —

Thanks for the questions. Below is a concise offer that answers your bullets. See attached updated pricing workbook for the math.

Summary (proposal):
- Commit model: Global committed pool (one annual commitment usable across US/EU/APAC).
- Commit tiers (annual tokens / discount off list):
  * Tier C: 100B tokens — 5% discount
  * Tier B: 250B tokens — 10% discount
  * Tier A: 500B tokens — 15% discount
- Pilot: 3-month pilot with a $25k committed credit (applied as an account credit); pilot overages billed at list rate.
- Cross-region overages / weighting: Global commit applies across regions. APAC-originated usage will be weighted at 1.03x for billing calculations (i.e., 1 APAC token counts as 1.03 tokens against the committed pool) to account for regional egress and support costs.
- APAC uplift: 3% surcharge applied to token charges originating from APAC if Acme requests APAC-dedicated hosting or local invoicing.
- EU VAT: list rates are VAT-exclusive; we will invoice with VAT where required and provide net pricing in the SOW.
- Rollover: optional 6-month rollover at 50% credit value for unused committed tokens (must be elected at signing).
- SOC 2: Grace will provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and standard security addendum (I’ll attach).

Next steps:
1) If this matches expectations, we’ll prepare a DocuSign quote and a short SOW with the commit amount and the APAC weighting language.
2) Procurement: if you need region-specific commits instead, we can show an alternate quote but pricing will not be as favorable.

Attached: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_2025.xlsx (updated v2).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0170

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_2025.xlsx
From: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@acme-retail.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quote and cross-region pricing (updated)

Marissa / Jordan —

This looks good and aligns with our runway. A few final asks before we sign:
- Please include explicit language in the SOW about APAC weighting (1.03x) and the 3% APAC surcharge option — procurement requires deterministic math.
- Confirm how unused committed tokens are reconciled at year-end if we do not elect rollover. Is there a buyback rate?
- We’d like a 3% one-time onboarding credit on top of the pilot if we go straight to an annual commit. Can you confirm?

If you can send a DocuSign-ready quote with those items, procurement will route to legal. We’re aiming to sign by end of month if numbers hold.

Thanks,
Katie
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Liao <katie.liao@acme-retail.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quote and cross-region pricing (updated)

Katie —

Appreciate the quick review. Confirmations below and next steps:

- SOW language: we will insert deterministic wording: APAC-weighting = 1.03x applied to APAC-originated calls; the optional APAC surcharge (3%) is applied only if Acme elects APAC-dedicated hosting/local invoicing.
- Unused committed tokens: if no rollover elected, year-end unused tokens will be forfeited; we can offer a one-time buyback at 25% of list value for the remaining unused tokens as a middle ground.
- Onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time 3% onboarding credit on the first-year invoice if Acme signs an annual commit now.

I’ll prepare the DocuSign quote (DocuSign_Quote_00078.pdf) and short SOW and share the HubSpot link for tracking. Legal will include the security addendum and SOC 2 attestation (Grace is attaching). Expect the DocuSign link in the next 24 hours.

Call scheduled: Tue 8/19 9am PST to walk procurement if useful — I’ll send calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
